summary: Regression + Live Video Detection E2E after code-cleanup (logging in 3 catch blocks). All 28 pytest cases pass, including new test_video_upload_and_clip_playback that synthesizes a tiny mp4, POSTs /api/cameras/{id}/video, polls /video/status to done, and validates /clip returns real YOLO frames with (frame_url, slots, free/occupied/unknown/total). Frontend regression E2E: client + developer login, /api/auth/me (Bearer), logout; client /app renders SlotCanvas + FREE/OCCUPIED/UNKNOWN chips + camera-switcher (3) + nearest-free-banner + webcam-toggle; clip-backed camera shows feed-source-badge='Real footage · YOLO', clip-playback-controls with playpause/prev/next/scrubber, scrubbing pauses playback and ws-status flips to 'PLAYBACK'; developer /ops/cameras (Metro Mall) shows 3 dev-camera-tab-* tabs, Upload Clip (real YOLO), Save Slot Map, add-camera / fare-config; /ops/enquiries convert button present; /ops/tickets reply+status+send testids present per ticket; /ops/health renders KPIs. Multi-client isolation confirmed via 403 on cross-client cameras/history. Non-cookie Bearer auth flow works, unauth GET /clip returns 401.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/TryDetection.jsx used a helper named `useSample`, which the eslint react-hooks/rules-of-hooks rule (correctly) flagged as an illegal hook call inside JSX callbacks and produced a CRA compile-error overlay that intercepted all pointer events, silently blocking the login button in dev builds. Renamed to `applySample` (both definition and call-site) to restore the frontend. This was NOT part of the reported 3-catch-block cleanup, but was a pre-existing regression that surfaced when the dev server recompiled. Please keep hook-name discipline (only prefix with `use` when the function itself calls hooks).

server.py is now 1022 lines (was 807) — clip playback / video upload / CLIP cache / process_video / occupancy_loop live together. Split into routers/cameras.py, routers/video.py, realtime/occupancy.py, realtime/clip_playback.py.

CLIP and VIDEO_JOBS are in-process module-level dicts, so multi-worker deployment (>1 uvicorn worker) will fragment clip playback state across workers. Move to Mongo or Redis if scaling beyond a single worker.

/api/files/{path} is still un-auth-enforced despite accepting `auth` param (noted in iter-1); clip frame_url paths (/api/files/EzySlot/clips/{cam}/{i}.jpg) are effectively public, which may leak client footage. Enforce scope_client_id lookup on file serve.

process_video swallows errors into VIDEO_JOBS but doesn't clear stale 'processing' state on server restart; on cold start you could see an infinite 'processing' UI. Persist job state in Mongo or wipe on startup.
